title: Assertion: Bus Address Alignment
constraints: `size`: 0 = byte, 1 = halfword, 2 = word, 3 = reserved. When `valid = 1`: halfwords need `addr[0] = 0`, words need `addr[1:0] = 0`, and size 3 is illegal.
While `valid && !ready`, `addr` and `size` must stay stable into the next cycle.
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: One implication per size, or one property: `valid |-> size != 3 && (addr & ((1 << size) - 1)) == 0`.

examples.title: aligned
examples.input: word at 0x40, halfword at 0x42, byte at 0x43
